name: studywidbuddy
description: Learn together, build together, grow together.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/api test && npm --prefix apps/web test
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
